elsewhere.note: yet I tell you that even Solomon in all his glory was not dressed like one of these.
A certain young man followed him, having a linen cloth thrown around himself over his naked body. The young men grabbed him,
Consider the lilies, how they grow. They don’t toil, neither do they spin; yet I tell you, even Solomon in all his glory was not arrayed like one of these.
The soldiers twisted thorns into a crown, and put it on his head, and dressed him in a purple garment.
The angel said to him, “Get dressed and put on your sandals.” He did so. He said to him, “Put on your cloak and follow me.”
He who overcomes will be arrayed in white garments, and I will in no way blot his name out of the book of life, and I will confess his name before my Father…
